div.style: color: rgb(34, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
labels.py holds all 12 ids, contiguous 0..11, and every module
derives its map from it - tests/test_data.py asserts both.
Only ING and TAG have an I- continuation: DIS, NUT, ALG, STP,
TME and UDO are single-token B- only, and num carries no prefix,
which is why demo.entity_type special-cases it.
